## supply	3
supply.sbom	certain	image	-	-	-	SBOM present: SPDX-2.3, 70 packages	A software bill of materials travels with the image.
supply.sbom-drift	hint	image	-	-	-	1 declared OS package is not installed, 1 installed at another version	The SBOM declares OS packages the image's package database does not list as declared: it may describe another build of the image.
supply.undeclared	certain	image	L4	/var/lib/dpkg/status	-	3 installed packages the SBOM does not list: curl, libcurl4, netcat-openbsd	The image's own package database lists them as installed; the SBOM that travels with it does not declare them. Whoever relies on the SBOM, for licences or for vulnerabilities, does not know they are there.
